long_biography.plain_text:
McElroy Manufacturing was already a family enterprise when Arthur H. "Chip" McElroy II moved into its top ranks. His parents, Art and Panny, had turned a Tulsa garage workshop into a specialist in finned-tube systems and thermoplastic-pipe fusion equipment. With engineering training from the University of Tulsa, their son assumed overall direction in 1997 alongside sisters Donna Dutton and Peggy Tanner.

Governance work later broadened his industrial reach. McElroy chairs specialty sheet-metal producer Southern Specialties, is a director of aerospace supplier Pryer Aerospace and joined AAON's board in 2007. He subsequently became the HVAC manufacturer's independent chairman, overseeing governance and compensation matters. Across these appointments, his career remains centered on engineering-led production, family-business continuity and long-term corporate stewardship.
